Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: Alfred Shen
Message:
Wave C2b+D: real composition, compose stack, Web UI, e2e, perf smoke

Residual closer; integrator wiring of every Services field, entrypoints,
bootstrap, compose app profile (2 api replicas, jobs, media worker +
sandbox, wire mock, moto, postgres, valkey, toxiproxy), images without
test deps; React UI W1/W2/W4/W7 with dev cookie proxy; e2e suite (52)
across both replicas, Playwright (11); load harness and perf smoke
report; integration review (12 findings, all addressed).
Verified by orchestrator: make check all green (unit 2842, conformance
757, integration 525, sdk), make e2e 52/52 twice on a fresh stack,
ui-check 75, ui-e2e 11 passed / 1 skipped.
Perf: SLO NOT met (one process ~150 streams; overhead p50 13.8 / p95
29.3 ms at 50 streams) - see reports/perf/c2b-perf-smoke.md.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Description: Uncovered a JSON Web Token, which may lead to unauthorized access to web applications and sensitive user data.
Author: Alfred Shen
Message:
Wave B foundation: frozen core, contracts, config, db, api, telemetry, fakes, infra

B1 platform scaffold (uv lock, 250 pkgs; botocore 1.43.106 with Converse
outputConfig), B2 db schema + repos (RLS, SECURITY DEFINER), api skeleton
(ingress middleware, typed envelopes, 501 stubs, contract validator),
fakes + conformance suites + golden SSE, telemetry, infra + media image;
B3 verify + interface review (44 findings), B4 fixes.
Orchestrator: contract rev 6 declares 400 on 9 operations; malformed path
ids are 404 (IMPL-030 amendment); undeclared-400 allowance removed.
make check green: unit 751, conformance 423, integration 329; media 10.
